name: World Builder
description: Describe locations, time periods, weather, and sensory atmosphere

macros.f1: Write a scene set in a quiet coffee shop during an evening rainstorm.
macros.f2: Describe a misty autumn morning in an old European city square.
macros.f3: Write a scene set in a bustling marketplace at midday in a fantasy world.
macros.f4: Describe an abandoned lighthouse during a winter storm at night.
macros.f5: Write a sunset scene on a remote beach where the tide is coming in.
